Deposition 2 - Testimony excerpt

Terry Imig | September 3, 2015

Excerpt only, reproduced from Q&A quoted in the court filing. This is not a complete deposition transcript.
Original transcript reference: page 37. Located on PDF page 14 (printed page 8) of the source filing.
Q. Okay. My question is, when you applied your brakes, was there anything about the condition of the road
that you believe prevented your truck from coming to a stop right away.
A. No.
Source: Plaintiff-Appellant's Application for Leave to Appeal, filed October 18, 2018, Menard v. Imig
(Michigan Supreme Court No. 158563).
Open the original court filing

Deposition 1 - Testimony excerpt

Terry Imig | February 11, 2015

Excerpt only, reproduced from Q&A quoted in the court filing. This is not a complete deposition transcript.
Original transcript reference: pages 65-66. Located on PDF page 13 (printed page 7) of the source filing.
The * * * omission marker appears in the source quotation.
Q. Did you hit the brakes?
A. Yes.
Q. Did the condition of the road with the potholes or anything else that was on the road affect your ability to
stop your vehicle without hitting the boy?
A. I believe it increased my stopping distance.
* * *
Q. And I can only ask you based on your observation that night, either before or after this accident occurred,
the conditions of the road when you went to hit your brakes, if it increased your stopping distance?
A. I'm sure it did.
Source: Plaintiff-Appellant's Application for Leave to Appeal, filed October 18, 2018, Menard v. Imig
(Michigan Supreme Court No. 158563).
Open the original court filing
